prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
engine_stated_criteria: all plans available in your state and county
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for individual or family coverage: it’s an independent Kansas City–area agency, says it compares Marketplace and private plans across carriers, and reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. Call **816-205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

Another option is **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** in Overland Park, which says it helps compare ACA plans, check subsidy eligibility, and verify doctors and hospitals are in-network. Call **913-333-8627** or visit [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/).

Before enrolling, ask whether the broker can compare **all plans available in your state and county**, whether your doctors and prescriptions are covered, and how they’re compensated. Broker help is often free, but confirm that they’ll check Marketplace subsidy eligibility and explain any plans that aren’t ACA-compliant.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
